<style>
 
.microscope-collection {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    --specimen-card-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--entry, #ffffff) 90%, var(--secondary, #777777) 10%);
    --specimen-preview-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme, #ffffff) 92%, var(--secondary, #777777) 8%);
    --specimen-border: var(--border, #d8d8d8);
    --specimen-fg: var(--primary, #222222);
    --specimen-accent: #da695d;
    --scope-control-axis: 26px;  
}

.scope-container {
    width: 700px;
    height: auto;
    margin: 5px auto 50px auto;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 700px; 
}

.specimen-info {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    padding: 0;
}

.specimen-name {
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.specimen-description {
    line-height: 1.6;
    font-size: 16px;
    max-width: 600px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.collection-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
}

.collection-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 0;
    padding-top: 5px;
}

.annotation-toggle-btn {
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.buttons-scroll-container {
    max-height: 800px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
     
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    touch-action: pan-y;
    padding: 5px 5px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--specimen-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: transparent;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: var(--tertiary, #aaa) transparent;
}

.collection-buttons {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: stretch;
}

 
.microscope-collection .fossa-specimen-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
}

.microscope-collection .fossa-specimen-card > .specimen-btn {
    height: auto;
    flex: 1;
}

.microscope-collection .fossa-specimen-page-link {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 5px 4px 7px;
    color: var(--secondary, #777);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.specimen-btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    border: 1px solid var(--specimen-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--specimen-card-bg);
    color: var(--specimen-fg);
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
     
    touch-action: pan-y;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    transition: border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
}

.specimen-btn-image-container {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--specimen-preview-bg);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--specimen-border);
}

.specimen-btn-image {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    object-fit: contain;  
}

.specimen-btn-text {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 54px;
    flex: 1 0 auto;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--specimen-fg);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.35;
    text-align: center;
    text-wrap: balance;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
    .specimen-btn:hover {
        border-color: var(--secondary, #888);
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14);
    }
}

.specimen-btn.active {
    border-color: var(--specimen-accent);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--specimen-accent), 0 3px 12px rgba(218, 105, 93, .15);
}

.specimen-btn.active .specimen-btn-text {
    color: var(--specimen-fg);
}

.specimen-btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--specimen-accent);
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

.scope-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    height: 700px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    background: black;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -moz-user-select: none;
    -ms-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.dzi-viewer {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.scope-loader {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
     
    pointer-events: none;
}

.scope-loader * {
    pointer-events: none;
}

.loader-spinner {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-top: 4px solid #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
}

.loader-text {
    color: white;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    text-align: center;
}

 
.scope-tile-status {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 32px;
    z-index: 30;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 36px);
    padding: 7px 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(23, 27, 34, .88);
    color: #fff;
    font: 500 12px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif;
    white-space: nowrap;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translate(-50%, 5px);
    transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease, visibility .2s;
}

.scope-tile-status.is-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translate(-50%, 0);
}

.scope-tile-status-spinner {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    flex: none;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .3);
    border-top-color: #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: scope-tile-spin .8s linear infinite;
}

.scope-tile-status[data-state="complete"] .scope-tile-status-spinner {
    display: none;
}

@keyframes scope-tile-spin {
    to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .scope-tile-status {
        bottom: 18px;
        padding: 5px 9px;
        font-size: 11px;
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .scope-tile-status-spinner { animation: none; }
    .scope-tile-status { transition: none; }
}

@keyframes spin {
    0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg); }
    100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); }
}

.scope-aberration {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -20px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    opacity: 0.8;
}

.scope-aberration::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -15px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at center,
        rgba(255,0,0,0) 50%,
        rgba(255,50,0,0.6) 60%,
        rgba(255,0,0,0.9) 100%
    );
    transform: scale(1.1);
    filter: blur(3px);
}

.scope-aberration::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 3px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at center,
        rgba(0,0,255,0) 50%,
        rgba(0,100,255,0.6) 90%,
        rgba(0,0,255,0.9) 90%
    );
    transform: scale(0.95);
    filter: blur(2px);
}

.scope-vignette {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at center,
        rgba(0,0,0,0) 60%,
        rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 80%,
        rgba(0,0,0,0.9) 90%
    );
    z-index: 3;
}

.scope-with-glow {
    position: relative;
    width: 700px;
    height: 700px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.scope-glow {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -40px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: -1;
    background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%,
            rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.6) 0%,
            rgba(80, 180, 240, 0.4) 15%,
            rgba(60, 160, 220, 0.2) 30%,
            transparent 60%
        ),
        radial-gradient(circle at 60% 60%,
            rgba(255, 220, 100, 0.5) 0%,
            rgba(240, 200, 80, 0.3) 15%,
            rgba(220, 180, 60, 0.1) 30%,
            transparent 60%
        );
    filter: blur(35px);
}

.scope-glare {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 4;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,
        rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 0%,
        rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%
    );
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .scope-container {
        width: 95vw;
        height: auto;
        max-width: 500px;
        max-height: none;
        padding-right: 0;
        min-height: auto;
        margin: 5px auto 35px auto;
    }

    .specimen-info {
        margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

.lens-effect {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 5;
    opacity: 0;
}

.lens-focus-in {
    animation: focusIn 0.8s ease-out forwards;
}

.lens-focus-out {
    animation: focusOut 0.6s ease-in forwards;
}

@keyframes focusIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 30%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 50%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
        );
        transform: scale(0.8);
        filter: blur(15px);
    }
    20% {
        opacity: 1;
        filter: blur(10px);
    }
    50% {
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 0%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 40%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 60%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 80%
        );
        filter: blur(5px);
    }
    80% {
        opacity: 0.8;
        filter: blur(2px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 20%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 40%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 60%
        );
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(0px);
    }
}

@keyframes focusOut {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 30%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 50%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%
        );
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(5px);
    }
    30% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        filter: blur(8px);
    }
    60% {
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 0%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 40%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 60%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 80%
        );
        filter: blur(12px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.9);
        filter: blur(15px);
    }
}

.lens-chromatic {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 6;
    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
}

.chromatic-in {
    animation: chromaticIn 0.7s ease-out forwards;
}

.chromatic-out {
    animation: chromaticOut 0.5s ease-in forwards;
}

@keyframes chromaticIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: 
            radial-gradient(circle at 45% 45%, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 55% 55%, rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.3) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.3) 0%, transparent 50%);
        transform: scale(0.9);
        filter: blur(12px);
    }
    30% {
        opacity: 0.8;
        filter: blur(6px);
    }
    60% {
        opacity: 0.6;
        filter: blur(3px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(0px);
    }
}

@keyframes chromaticOut {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: 
            radial-gradient(circle at 55% 55%, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 45% 45%, rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%);
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(5px);
    }
    40% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        filter: blur(8px);
    }
    80% {
        opacity: 0.3;
        filter: blur(12px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.9);
        filter: blur(15px);
    }
}

.lens-flare {
    position: absolute;
    top: 20%;
    left: 20%;
    width: 30%;
    height: 30%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 7;
    opacity: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(
        ellipse at center,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 30%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
    );
}

.flare-in {
    animation: flareIn 0.8s ease-out forwards;
}

.flare-out {
    animation: flareOut 0.6s ease-in forwards;
}

@keyframes flareIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(0deg);
    }
    25% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        transform: scale(1.2) rotate(90deg);
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.4;
        transform: scale(1) rotate(180deg);
    }
    75% {
        opacity: 0.2;
        transform: scale(0.8) rotate(270deg);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(360deg);
    }
}

@keyframes flareOut {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(0deg);
    }
    25% {
        opacity: 0.6;
        transform: scale(1.1) rotate(-90deg);
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.3;
        transform: scale(0.9) rotate(-180deg);
    }
    75% {
        opacity: 0.1;
        transform: scale(0.7) rotate(-270deg);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(-360deg);
    }
}

function originalMicronsPerPixel(specimen, imageWidth) {
  const direct = Number(specimen?.image_microns_per_pixel);
  if (Number.isFinite(direct) && direct > 0) return direct;
  const legacy = Number(specimen?.microns_per_pixel);
  return Number.isFinite(legacy) && legacy > 0 && Number.isFinite(imageWidth) && imageWidth > 0
    ? legacy * 700 * (149 / 154) / imageWidth : null;
}

function measureSegment(start, end, specimen, imageWidth) {
  const pixels = Math.hypot(end.x - start.x, end.y - start.y);
  const scale = originalMicronsPerPixel(specimen, imageWidth);
  return { pixels, microns: scale === null ? null : pixels * scale };
}

function formatMeasurement(measurement, preferredUnit = '', missingScaleText = 'масштаб не задан') {
  if (measurement.microns === null) return `${Number(measurement.pixels.toFixed(2))} px · ${missingScaleText}`;
  const mm = preferredUnit === 'mm' || (!preferredUnit && measurement.microns >= 1000);
  return `${Number((measurement.microns / (mm ? 1000 : 1)).toPrecision(5))} ${mm ? 'mm' : 'µm'}`;
}




function bindImagePointDrag({ element, viewer, blocked, move, click }) {
  let drag = null;
  let suppressClick = false;
  const press = event => {
    if (blocked() || event.button !== 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    suppressClick = false;
    drag = {
      id: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY,
      offsetX: event.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2,
      offsetY: event.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2,
      navigation: viewer.isMouseNavEnabled(), moved: false,
    };
    viewer.setMouseNavEnabled(false);
    element.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  };
  const update = event => {
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.id || blocked()) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (Math.hypot(event.clientX - drag.x, event.clientY - drag.y) > 2) drag.moved = true;
    if (!drag.moved) return;
    const rect = viewer.element.getBoundingClientRect();
    move({ x: event.clientX - rect.left - drag.offsetX, y: event.clientY - rect.top - drag.offsetY });
  };
  const release = event => {
    if (!drag || (event && event.pointerId !== drag.id)) return;
    event?.stopPropagation();
    const previous = drag;
    drag = null;
    suppressClick = previous.moved;
    if (element.hasPointerCapture(previous.id)) element.releasePointerCapture(previous.id);
    viewer.setMouseNavEnabled(previous.navigation && !blocked());
  };
  const activate = event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (!blocked() && !suppressClick) click();
    suppressClick = false;
  };
  element.addEventListener('pointerdown', press);
  element.addEventListener('pointermove', update);
  element.addEventListener('click', activate);
  for (const name of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture']) element.addEventListener(name, release);
  return { destroy() {
    release();
    element.removeEventListener('pointerdown', press);
    element.removeEventListener('pointermove', update);
    element.removeEventListener('click', activate);
    for (const name of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture']) element.removeEventListener(name, release);
  } };
}

  viewer.addHandler('canvas-press', event => {
    if (!drawing || event.originalEvent?.button > 0) return;
    const point = pointAt(event.position);
    if (!point) return;

  });
  viewer.addHandler('canvas-drag', event => {
    if (!drawing || !dragging) return;

  });
  for (const handle of handles) {
    const key = handle.dataset.endpoint;
    bindImagePointDrag({ element: handle, viewer, blocked: () => !active || drawing || !segment,
      move: position => { segment[key] = pointAt(new OpenSeadragon.Point(position.x, position.y), true); update(); },
      click: () => handle.focus(),
    });

      if (!active || drawing || !segment) return;
      const delta = { ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0], ArrowUp: [0, -1], ArrowDown: [0, 1] }[event.key];
      if (!delta) return;
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
      const size = viewer.world.getItemAt(0).getContentSize(), step = event.shiftKey ? 10 : 1;
      segment[key] = { x: Math.max(0, Math.min(size.x, segment[key].x + delta[0] * step)), y: Math.max(0, Math.min(size.y, segment[key].y + delta[1] * step)) };
      update();

  }

  for (const name of ['animation', 'zoom', 'pan', 'resize']) viewer.addHandler(name, update);
}

const EPS = 1e-12;
const cross = (a, b, c) => (b.x-a.x)*(c.y-a.y) - (b.y-a.y)*(c.x-a.x);
const onSegment = (point, a, b) => Math.abs(cross(a, b, point)) <= EPS &&
  point.x >= Math.min(a.x,b.x)-EPS && point.x <= Math.max(a.x,b.x)+EPS &&
  point.y >= Math.min(a.y,b.y)-EPS && point.y <= Math.max(a.y,b.y)+EPS;

function polygonArea(vertices) {
  return Math.abs(vertices.reduce((sum, point, i) => {
    const next = vertices[(i+1)%vertices.length];
    return sum + point.x*next.y - next.x*point.y;
  }, 0))/2;
}

function validPolygon(vertices) {
  if (!Array.isArray(vertices) || vertices.length < 3 || vertices.length > 1000 ||
      vertices.some(p => !p || !Number.isFinite(p.x) || !Number.isFinite(p.y) || p.x < 0 || p.x > 1 || p.y < 0 || p.y > 1) ||
      polygonArea(vertices) <= EPS) return false;
  for (let i=0; i<vertices.length; i++) {
    const a = vertices[i], b = vertices[(i+1)%vertices.length];
    if (Math.hypot(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y) <= EPS) return false;
    for (let j=i+1; j<vertices.length; j++) {
      if (j === i+1 || (i === 0 && j === vertices.length-1)) continue;
      const c = vertices[j], d = vertices[(j+1)%vertices.length];
      const abC = cross(a,b,c), abD = cross(a,b,d), cdA = cross(c,d,a), cdB = cross(c,d,b);
      if ((abC*abD < -EPS*EPS && cdA*cdB < -EPS*EPS) ||
          onSegment(c,a,b) || onSegment(d,a,b) || onSegment(a,c,d) || onSegment(b,c,d)) return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}


function pointInPolygon(point, vertices) {
  let inside = false;
  for (let i=0, j=vertices.length-1; i<vertices.length; j=i++) {
    const a = vertices[j], b = vertices[i];
    if (onSegment(point,a,b)) return true;
    if ((a.y > point.y) !== (b.y > point.y) && point.x < (b.x-a.x)*(point.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x) inside = !inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';



function renderPolygonAnnotations({ viewer, container, layer, groups }) {
  const svg = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
  svg.classList.add('annotation-polygons');
  svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  const regions = [];
  for (const group of groups) {
    for (const vertices of Array.isArray(group.polygons) ? group.polygons : []) {
      if (!validPolygon(vertices)) continue;
      const polygon = document.createElementNS(NS, 'polygon');
      polygon.classList.add('annotation-polygon');
      polygon.dataset.groupId = group.id;
      polygon.style.stroke = group.color || '#ff4444';
      svg.append(polygon);
      const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
      tooltip.className = 'annotation-tooltip annotation-polygon-tooltip';
      tooltip.style.borderLeftColor = group.color || '#ff4444';
      const lang = document.documentElement.lang || 'ru';
      const heading = document.createElement('strong');
      heading.textContent = group.labels?.[lang] || group.labels?.ru || group.label || 'Область';
      const description = group.description?.[lang] || group.description?.ru ||
        (typeof group.description === 'string' ? group.description : '');
      tooltip.append(heading, document.createElement('br'), document.createTextNode(description));
      regions.push({ vertices, polygon, tooltip });
    }
  }
  if (!regions.length) return () => {};
  layer.append(svg, ...regions.map(region => region.tooltip));
  let pointer = null;
  function hide() {
    regions.forEach(region => {
      region.tooltip.classList.remove('is-visible');
      region.polygon.classList.remove('is-hovered');
    });
  }
  function hover() {
    hide();
    const item = viewer.world.getItemAt(0);
    if (!pointer || !item) return;
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pixel = new OpenSeadragon.Point(pointer.x-rect.left, pointer.y-rect.top);
    const image = item.viewportToImageCoordinates(viewer.viewport.pointFromPixel(pixel, true));
    const size = item.getContentSize();
    const point = { x: image.x/size.x, y: image.y/size.y };
    const region = regions.findLast(candidate => pointInPolygon(point, candidate.vertices));
    if (!region) return;
    region.polygon.classList.add('is-hovered');
    region.tooltip.classList.add('is-visible');
    region.tooltip.style.left = Math.max(6, Math.min(pixel.x+14, rect.width-region.tooltip.offsetWidth-6))+'px';
    region.tooltip.style.top = Math.max(6, Math.min(pixel.y+14, rect.height-region.tooltip.offsetHeight-6))+'px';
  }
  function update() {
    const item = viewer.world.getItemAt(0);
    if (!item) return;
    const size = item.getContentSize();
    for (const region of regions) {
      region.polygon.setAttribute('points', region.vertices.map(point => {
        const screen = viewer.viewport.viewportToViewerElementCoordinates(item.imageToViewportCoordinates(point.x*size.x, point.y*size.y));
        return `${screen.x},${screen.y}`;
      }).join(' '));
    }
    hover();
  }
  const move = event => { pointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY }; hover(); };
  const leave = () => { pointer = null; hide(); };
  container.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
  container.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);
  const events = ['open', 'animation', 'zoom', 'pan', 'resize'];
  events.forEach(name => viewer.addHandler(name, update));
  update();
  return () => {
    container.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
    container.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);
    events.forEach(name => viewer.removeHandler(name, update));
    svg.remove();
    regions.forEach(region => region.tooltip.remove());
  };
}

function clearAnnotations() {
    annotationDisposers.forEach(dispose => dispose());
    annotationDisposers = [];
    document.getElementById(`annotations-${id}`)?.replaceChildren();
}

function renderAnnotations() {
        const annotationsLayer = document.getElementById(`annotations-${id}`);
    
    if (!annotationsLayer || !viewer) return;
    if (!currentAnnotations.length) {
        clearAnnotations();
        return;
    }

    clearAnnotations();
    annotationDisposers.push(renderPolygonAnnotations({
        viewer, container: viewerContainer, layer: annotationsLayer, groups: currentAnnotations
    }));

    currentAnnotations.forEach((group, groupIndex) => {
        if (!group.points || !Array.isArray(group.points)) return;

        
        const groupColor = group.color || '#ff4444';
        

        group.points.forEach((point, pointIndex) => {
            const marker = document.createElement('div');
            marker.className = 'annotation-marker';
            marker.dataset.groupId = group.id;
            marker.dataset.pointIndex = pointIndex;

            
            marker.style.borderColor = groupColor;
            marker.style.boxShadow = `0 0 8px ${groupColor}80`; 

            const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
            tooltip.className = 'annotation-tooltip';
            tooltip.style.borderLeftColor = groupColor;             
            const currentLang = document.documentElement.lang || 'ru';
            const label = group.labels?.[currentLang] || group.labels?.ru || group.label || 'Объект';
            const description = group.description?.[currentLang] || group.description?.ru || group.description || '';
            
            tooltip.innerHTML = `
                <strong>${label}</strong><br>
                ${description}
            `;


function updateMarkerPosition() {
        
    try {
     
        const tiledImage = viewer.world.getItemAt(0);
        
     
        const imagePoint = new OpenSeadragon.Point(
            point.x * tiledImage.source.dimensions.x,
            point.y * tiledImage.source.dimensions.y
        );
        

        const viewportPoint = tiledImage.imageToViewportCoordinates(imagePoint);
        
      
        const screenPoint = viewer.viewport.viewportToViewerElementCoordinates(viewportPoint);
        

        if (screenPoint && !isNaN(screenPoint.x) && !isNaN(screenPoint.y)) {
            marker.style.left = screenPoint.x + 'px';
            marker.style.top = screenPoint.y + 'px';
            

            tooltip.style.left = (screenPoint.x + 12) + 'px';
            tooltip.style.top = (screenPoint.y + 12) + 'px';
   
            const zoom = viewer.viewport.getZoom();
            const baseSize = 40;
            const zoomFactor = Math.min(Math.max(zoom / 3, 0.3), 3); 
            const markerSize = baseSize * zoomFactor;
            
            marker.style.width = markerSize + 'px';
            marker.style.height = markerSize + 'px';
            marker.style.borderWidth = Math.max(1, 2 * zoomFactor) + 'px';
        } else {
            console.log('X', screenPoint);
        }
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('XX', error);
    }
}


marker.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    
    if (viewer) {
        const tiledImage = viewer.world.getItemAt(0);
        const imagePoint = new OpenSeadragon.Point(
            point.x * tiledImage.source.dimensions.x,
            point.y * tiledImage.source.dimensions.y
        );
        const viewportPoint = tiledImage.imageToViewportCoordinates(imagePoint);
        
              
        viewer.viewport.panTo(viewportPoint, true);
        viewer.viewport.zoomTo(8, null, true);
    }
});




let touchStartZoom = 1;
let touchStartDistance = 0;

marker.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    if (e.touches.length === 2) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        
        touchStartZoom = viewer.viewport.getZoom();
        touchStartDistance = Math.hypot(
            e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
            e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
        );
    }
}, { passive: false });



marker.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    
    if (viewer && viewer.viewport && viewer.world.getItemAt(0)) {
        const tiledImage = viewer.world.getItemAt(0);
        const viewport = viewer.viewport;
        
        const imagePoint = new OpenSeadragon.Point(
            point.x * tiledImage.source.dimensions.x,
            point.y * tiledImage.source.dimensions.y
        );
        const viewportPoint = tiledImage.imageToViewportCoordinates(imagePoint);
        

        const zoomFactor = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
        
 
        
 
        viewer.viewport.zoomBy(zoomFactor, viewportPoint);
        
 
        setTimeout(updateScaleBar, 100);
    }
}, { passive: false });




         
            marker.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (viewer) {
                    viewer.viewport.panTo(
                        new OpenSeadragon.Point(point.x, point.y),
                        true
                    );
                    viewer.viewport.zoomTo(8);
                }
            });

            annotationsLayer.appendChild(marker);
            annotationsLayer.appendChild(tooltip);
            
            updateMarkerPosition();
            
 
            viewer.addHandler('zoom', updateMarkerPosition);
            viewer.addHandler('pan', updateMarkerPosition);
            viewer.addHandler('resize', updateMarkerPosition);
            viewer.addHandler('animation', updateMarkerPosition);
            annotationDisposers.push(() => {
                ['zoom', 'pan', 'resize', 'animation'].forEach(name => {
                    viewer.removeHandler(name, updateMarkerPosition);
                });
            });
        });
    });
    

}



    function toggleAnnotations() {
    showAnnotations = !showAnnotations;
    const button = document.getElementById(`toggle-annotations-${id}`);
    const annotationsLayer = document.getElementById(`annotations-${id}`);

  
    updateAnnotationButtonText();

    if (showAnnotations) {
        button.classList.add('active');
        if (currentAnnotations.length > 0) {
            renderAnnotations();
        } else {
            setTimeout(() => {
                showAnnotations = false;
                updateAnnotationButtonText();
                button.classList.remove('active');
            }, 1000);
        }
    } else {
        button.classList.remove('active');
        

        if (viewer && annotationsLayer) {
            clearAnnotations();
        }
    }
}


function initialize() {
    
    if (typeof OpenSeadragon === 'undefined') {
        console.log('OpenSeadragon еще не загружен, ждем...');
        setTimeout(initialize, 100);
        return;
    }

    initOpenSeadragon();
    if (!singleMode) {
        initSpecimenButtons();
    }

    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById(`toggle-annotations-${id}`);
    
    if (toggleBtn) {
        showAnnotations = false;
        updateAnnotationButtonText();
        toggleBtn.classList.remove('active');
        
        toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleAnnotations);
    } else {
        console.log('XXX');
    }

    let resizeTimeout;
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            if (viewer && currentSpecimen) {
                updateScaleBar();
            }
        }, 250);
    });

    if (specimens.length > 0) {
        setTimeout(() => loadSpecimen(0), 500);
    }
}







function compactClampZoom(value) {
    return Math.max(1, Math.min(50, value));
}

function applyCompactInitialZoom() {
    if (!compactMode || !viewer || !viewer.viewport) return;
    const width = viewerContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    if (!(width > 0)) return;
    compactLastWidth = width;
    
    
    const zoom = viewer.viewport.getZoom(true);
    const targetZoom = compactClampZoom(zoom * 700 / width);
    viewer.viewport.zoomTo(targetZoom, null, true);
    updateScaleBar();
}

function handleCompactResize() {
    if (!compactMode || !viewer || !viewer.viewport || !currentSpecimen) return;
    const width = viewerContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    if (!(width > 0)) return;
    if (compactLastWidth > 0 && Math.abs(width - compactLastWidth) > 0.5) {
        
        const previousWidth = compactLastWidth;
        compactLastWidth = width;
        const zoom = viewer.viewport.getZoom(true);
        viewer.viewport.zoomTo(compactClampZoom(zoom * previousWidth / width), null, true);
    } else {
        compactLastWidth = width;
    }
    updateScaleBar();
}

function updateScaleBar() {
    
    
    
    
    const REFERENCE_SCOPE_WIDTH = 700;
    
    
    
    
    const GLOBAL_SCALE_CORRECTION = 149 / 154; 
    const barLine = document.querySelector(`#scale-bar-${id} .scale-bar-line`);
    const barText = document.getElementById(`scale-bar-text-${id}`);
    if (!barLine || !barText) return;

    const hideBar = () => {
        barLine.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        barText.textContent = '—';
    };

    if (!viewer || !viewer.viewport || !viewer.world ||
        !viewer.world.getItemAt(0) || !currentSpecimen) {
        hideBar();
        return;
    }

    const legacyMPP = Number(currentSpecimen.microns_per_pixel);
    const imageMPP = Number(currentSpecimen.image_microns_per_pixel);
    const scopeWidth = viewerContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    
    const zoom = viewer.viewport.getZoom(true);

    if ((!((legacyMPP > 0) && Number.isFinite(legacyMPP)) &&
         !((imageMPP > 0) && Number.isFinite(imageMPP))) ||
        !(scopeWidth > 0) || !(zoom > 0) ||
        !Number.isFinite(scopeWidth) || !Number.isFinite(zoom)) {
        hideBar();
        return;
    }

    
    
    
    
    const micronsPerScreenPx =
        imageMPP > 0 && Number.isFinite(imageMPP)
            ? imageMPP / viewer.world.getItemAt(0).viewportToImageZoom(zoom)
            : (legacyMPP / zoom) * (REFERENCE_SCOPE_WIDTH / scopeWidth) * GLOBAL_SCALE_CORRECTION;

    
    
    const maxWidthPx = scopeWidth * 0.30;
    const maxMicrons = maxWidthPx * micronsPerScreenPx;
    if (!(maxMicrons > 0) || !Number.isFinite(maxMicrons)) {
        hideBar();
        return;
    }

    const power = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(maxMicrons)));
    let shownMicrons = power;
    for (const factor of [1, 2, 5, 10]) {
        if (factor * power <= maxMicrons) {
            shownMicrons = factor * power;
        }
    }
    const lineWidth = shownMicrons / micronsPerScreenPx;
    if (!(lineWidth > 0) || !Number.isFinite(lineWidth)) {
        hideBar();
        return;
    }

    barLine.style.width = `${lineWidth}px`;
    barLine.style.visibility = 'visible';
    const display = value => Number(value.toPrecision(5)).toString();
    const inMillimeters = currentSpecimen.calibration_unit === 'mm' ||
        (!currentSpecimen.calibration_unit && shownMicrons >= 1000);
    barText.textContent = inMillimeters
        ? `${display(shownMicrons / 1000)} mm`
        : `${display(shownMicrons)} µm`;
}

    function playLensEffect(isZoomIn) {
        if (isTransitioning) return;
        
        isTransitioning = true;
        
        
        lensEffect.className = 'lens-effect';
        lensChromatic.className = 'lens-chromatic';
        lensFlare.className = 'lens-flare';
        
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            
            if (isZoomIn) {
                lensEffect.classList.add('lens-focus-in');
                lensChromatic.classList.add('chromatic-in');
                lensFlare.classList.add('flare-in');
            } else {
                lensEffect.classList.add('lens-focus-out');
                lensChromatic.classList.add('chromatic-out');
                lensFlare.classList.add('flare-out');
            }
            
            
            
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                isTransitioning = false;
            }, 800);
        }, 50);
    }



    function handleZoomChange(newZoom) {
        lastZoomLevel = currentZoomLevel;
        currentZoomLevel = newZoom;
        
        
        const zoomThreshold = 0.2;
        const zoomChange = Math.abs(newZoom - lastZoomLevel) / lastZoomLevel;
        
        if (zoomChange >= zoomThreshold) {
            const isZoomIn = newZoom > lastZoomLevel;
            playLensEffect(isZoomIn);
        }
        
        
        updateScaleBar();
    }


    function initOpenSeadragon() {
        
        if (!viewerContainer) {
            console.error('Контейнер DZI viewer не найден');
            return;
        }

        try {
            viewer = OpenSeadragon({
                id: "dzi-viewer-" + id,
                prefixUrl: "",
                showNavigator: false,
                navigatorSizeRatio: 0.15,
                showZoomControl: false,
                showHomeControl: false,
                showFullPageControl: false,
                animationTime: 0.8,
                blendTime: 0.3,
                minZoomLevel: 1,
                maxZoomLevel: 50,
                gestureSettingsMouse: {
                    scrollToZoom: true
                },
                useCanvas: true,
                loadTilesWithAjax: false
            });


            installMeasurementTool({ viewer, getSpecimen: () => currentSpecimen });

            
            
            viewer.world.addHandler('add-item', function(event) {
                const tiledImage = event.item;
                tiledImage.addHandler('fully-loaded-change', function(state) {
                    if (viewer.world.getItemAt(0) !== tiledImage) return;
                    updateTileStatus(state.fullyLoaded);
                });
            });

            
            
            function onFirstTileReady(tiledImage) {
                if (!tiledImage || tiledImage !== viewer.world.getItemAt(0) || firstTileDrawn) return;
                firstTileDrawn = true;
                clearTimeout(firstTileFallbackTimer);
                firstTileFallbackTimer = null;
                hideLoader();
                updateTileStatus(tiledImage.getFullyLoaded());
            }

            viewer.addHandler('tile-loaded', function(event) {
                onFirstTileReady(event.tiledImage);
            });
            viewer.addHandler('tile-drawn', function(event) {
                onFirstTileReady(event.tiledImage);
            });

            viewer.addHandler('open', function() {

                
                
                const openedImage = viewer.world.getItemAt(0);
                clearTimeout(firstTileFallbackTimer);
                firstTileFallbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    onFirstTileReady(openedImage);
                }, 1800);
                
                
                currentZoomLevel = viewer.viewport.getZoom(true);
                lastZoomLevel = currentZoomLevel;
                if (typeof showZoomLevelIndicator === 'function') {
                    showZoomLevelIndicator();
                }
                
                
                
                applyCompactInitialZoom();

                
                setTimeout(updateScaleBar, 300);
            });

            
            viewer.addHandler('zoom', function(event) {
                const newZoom = event.zoom;
                handleZoomChange(newZoom);
            });

            
            viewer.addHandler('animation', updateScaleBar);

            
            viewer.addHandler('animation-finish', function(event) {
                const newZoom = viewer.viewport.getZoom(true);
                handleZoomChange(newZoom);
            });

            
            viewer.addHandler('resize', function() {
                handleCompactResize();
                updateScaleBar();
            });

            viewer.addHandler('open-failed', function(event) {
                console.error('Ошибка загрузки DZI:', event.message);
                loaderText.textContent = 'Ошибка загрузки';
                resetTileStatus();
                setTimeout(hideLoader, 2000);
                isTransitioning = false;
            });

        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Ошибка инициализации OpenSeadragon:', error);
            isTransitioning = false;
        }
    }


    function initSpecimenButtons() {
        specimens.forEach((specimen, index) => {
            const button = document.createElement('button');
            button.className = 'specimen-btn';
            const imageHolder = document.createElement('div');
            imageHolder.className = 'specimen-btn-image-container';
            const image = document.createElement('img');
            image.className = 'specimen-btn-image';
            image.src = specimen.buttonImage;
            image.alt = specimen.previewAlt || specimen.name;
            image.onerror = () => { image.style.display = 'none'; };
            imageHolder.appendChild(image);
            const label = document.createElement('div');
            label.className = 'specimen-btn-text';
            label.textContent = specimen.name;
            button.append(imageHolder, label);
            button.dataset.specimenId = index;
            
            
            
            
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                loadSpecimen(index);
            });

            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'fossa-specimen-card';
            card.appendChild(button);
            if (specimen.pageUrl) {
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.className = 'fossa-specimen-page-link';
                link.href = specimen.pageUrl;
                link.textContent = 'Страница препарата';
                link.setAttribute('aria-label', link.textContent + ': ' + specimen.name);
                card.appendChild(link);
            }
            specimenButtons.appendChild(card);
        });
    }


function normalizeSlideKey(value) {
    return String(value || '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/^\/+/, '')
        .replace(/^dzi\//i, '')
        .replace(/\.dzi$/i, '')
        .toLowerCase();
}


function getSpecimenIdFromUrl() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    
    
    const requestedSlide = shortcodeSlide || params.get('slide');

    if (!requestedSlide) {
        return 0;
    }

    const requestedKey = normalizeSlideKey(requestedSlide);

    const specimenId = specimens.findIndex(specimen =>
        normalizeSlideKey(specimen.dzi) === requestedKey
    );

    if (specimenId < 0) {
        console.warn(
            'Microscope slide not found:',
            requestedSlide,
            'available:',
            specimens.map(s => normalizeSlideKey(s.dzi))
        );
        return 0;
    }

    return specimenId;
}


function updateSpecimenUrl(specimen) {
    if (!specimen || !specimen.dzi) return;

    
    if (singleMode) return;

    const url = new URL(window.location.href);

    

    url.searchParams.set(
        'slide',
        normalizeSlideKey(specimen.dzi)
    );

    window.history.replaceState(
        { slide: specimen.dzi },
        '',
        url
    );
}



function loadSpecimen(specimenId) {
    const specimen = specimens[specimenId];
    if (!specimen) return;


    showAnnotations = false;
    updateAnnotationButtonText();
const toggleBtn = document.getElementById(`toggle-annotations-${id}`);

if (toggleBtn) {
    toggleBtn.classList.remove('active');

    const hasAnnotations =
        specimen.roi_file &&
        specimen.roi_file !== '""' &&
        specimen.roi_file.trim() !== '';

    toggleBtn.style.display = hasAnnotations ? 'block' : 'none';
}

    
    const annotationsLayer = document.getElementById(`annotations-${id}`);
    if (annotationsLayer) {
        clearAnnotations();
    }
    currentAnnotations = [];

    
    document.querySelectorAll(`#specimen-buttons-${id} .specimen-btn`).forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('active');
    });
    const activeButton = document.querySelector(`#specimen-buttons-${id} [data-specimen-id="${specimenId}"]`);
    if (activeButton) activeButton.classList.add('active');

    
    
    
    if (specimenName) {
        specimenName.textContent = specimen.name;
    }
    if (specimenDesc) {
        specimenDesc.textContent = specimen.description;
    }

    currentSpecimen = specimen;
    updateSpecimenUrl(specimen);
    
    
 
    
    if (specimen.roi_file && specimen.roi_file !== '""' && specimen.roi_file !== '') {
        loadAnnotations(specimen.roi_file);
    } else {

        currentAnnotations = [];
        if (annotationsLayer) {
            clearAnnotations();
        }
    }
    
    
    loadDZIPanorama(specimen.dzi);
}


    function loadDZIPanorama(dziFile) {
        resetTileStatus();
        
        const oldScaleLine = document.querySelector(`#scale-bar-${id} .scale-bar-line`);
        const oldScaleText = document.getElementById(`scale-bar-text-${id}`);
        if (oldScaleLine) oldScaleLine.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        if (oldScaleText) oldScaleText.textContent = '—';
        loaderText.textContent = 'Загрузка панорамы…';
        showLoader();

        if (!viewer) {
            console.error('OpenSeadragon viewer не инициализирован');
            return;
        }

        const dziPath = "/dzi/" + dziFile;
        viewer.open(dziPath);
    }

    function showLoader() {
        loader.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function hideLoader() {
        loader.style.display = 'none';
    }


    function initialize() {

        
        if (typeof OpenSeadragon === 'undefined') {
            setTimeout(initialize, 100);
            return;
        }

        initOpenSeadragon();
        if (compactMode && typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            
            
            const compactResizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(handleCompactResize);
            });
            compactResizeObserver.observe(viewerContainer);
        }
        if (!singleMode) {
            initSpecimenButtons();
        }

        const toggleBtn = document.getElementById(`toggle-annotations-${id}`);
        
        if (toggleBtn) {
            toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleAnnotations);
            console.log('YYYYY');
        } else {
            console.log('XXXXX');
        }

        let resizeTimeout;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
            resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                if (viewer && currentSpecimen) {
                    updateScaleBar();
                }
            }, 250);
        });

if (specimens.length > 0) {
    const initialSpecimenId = getSpecimenIdFromUrl();

    setTimeout(() => {
        loadSpecimen(initialSpecimenId);
    }, 500);
}
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initialize);
    } else {
        initialize();
    }


})();

.specimen-btn-image-container {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--specimen-preview-bg);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--specimen-border);
}

.specimen-btn-image {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    object-fit: contain;  
}

.specimen-btn-text {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 54px;
    flex: 1 0 auto;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--specimen-fg);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.35;
    text-align: center;
    text-wrap: balance;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
    .specimen-btn:hover {
        border-color: var(--secondary, #888);
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14);
    }
}

.specimen-btn.active {
    border-color: var(--specimen-accent);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--specimen-accent), 0 3px 12px rgba(218, 105, 93, .15);
}

.specimen-btn.active .specimen-btn-text {
    color: var(--specimen-fg);
}

.specimen-btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--specimen-accent);
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

.scope-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    height: 700px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    background: black;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -moz-user-select: none;
    -ms-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.dzi-viewer {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.scope-loader {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
     
    pointer-events: none;
}

.scope-loader * {
    pointer-events: none;
}

.loader-spinner {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-top: 4px solid #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
}

.loader-text {
    color: white;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    text-align: center;
}

 
.scope-tile-status {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 32px;
    z-index: 30;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 36px);
    padding: 7px 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(23, 27, 34, .88);
    color: #fff;
    font: 500 12px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif;
    white-space: nowrap;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translate(-50%, 5px);
    transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease, visibility .2s;
}

.scope-tile-status.is-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translate(-50%, 0);
}

.scope-tile-status-spinner {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    flex: none;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .3);
    border-top-color: #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: scope-tile-spin .8s linear infinite;
}

.scope-tile-status[data-state="complete"] .scope-tile-status-spinner {
    display: none;
}

@keyframes scope-tile-spin {
    to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .scope-tile-status {
        bottom: 18px;
        padding: 5px 9px;
        font-size: 11px;
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .scope-tile-status-spinner { animation: none; }
    .scope-tile-status { transition: none; }
}

@keyframes spin {
    0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg); }
    100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); }
}

.scope-aberration {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -20px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    opacity: 0.8;
}

.scope-aberration::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -15px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at center,
        rgba(255,0,0,0) 50%,
        rgba(255,50,0,0.6) 60%,
        rgba(255,0,0,0.9) 100%
    );
    transform: scale(1.1);
    filter: blur(3px);
}

.scope-aberration::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 3px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at center,
        rgba(0,0,255,0) 50%,
        rgba(0,100,255,0.6) 90%,
        rgba(0,0,255,0.9) 90%
    );
    transform: scale(0.95);
    filter: blur(2px);
}

.scope-vignette {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at center,
        rgba(0,0,0,0) 60%,
        rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 80%,
        rgba(0,0,0,0.9) 90%
    );
    z-index: 3;
}

.scope-with-glow {
    position: relative;
    width: 700px;
    height: 700px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.scope-glow {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -40px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: -1;
    background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%,
            rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.6) 0%,
            rgba(80, 180, 240, 0.4) 15%,
            rgba(60, 160, 220, 0.2) 30%,
            transparent 60%
        ),
        radial-gradient(circle at 60% 60%,
            rgba(255, 220, 100, 0.5) 0%,
            rgba(240, 200, 80, 0.3) 15%,
            rgba(220, 180, 60, 0.1) 30%,
            transparent 60%
        );
    filter: blur(35px);
}

.scope-glare {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 4;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,
        rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 0%,
        rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%
    );
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
}

    }

    }

@media (max-width: 480px) {

        height: auto;
        max-width: 400px;
        max-height: none;
        min-height: auto;

    }

    .specimen-name {
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .specimen-description {
        font-size: 13px;
        line-height: 1.35;
        max-width: 90vw;
    }
    
    .scope-with-glow {
        width: 90vw;
        height: 90vw;
        max-width: 400px;
        max-height: 400px;
    }
    
    .scope-wrapper {
        height: 100%;
        max-height: none;
    }
    
    .buttons-scroll-container {

    .collection-buttons {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

    }

    .specimen-btn-image-container {
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    }

    .specimen-btn-text {
        min-height: 58px;

    }

.openseadragon-container .openseadragon-controls {
    display: none !important;
}

.buttons-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar {

}

.buttons-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track {

}

.buttons-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {

.buttons-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {

.lens-effect {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 5;
    opacity: 0;
}

.lens-focus-in {
    animation: focusIn 0.8s ease-out forwards;
}

.lens-focus-out {
    animation: focusOut 0.6s ease-in forwards;
}

@keyframes focusIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 30%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 50%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
        );
        transform: scale(0.8);
        filter: blur(15px);
    }
    20% {
        opacity: 1;
        filter: blur(10px);
    }
    50% {
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 0%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 40%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 60%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 80%
        );
        filter: blur(5px);
    }
    80% {
        opacity: 0.8;
        filter: blur(2px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 20%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 40%,
            rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 60%
        );
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(0px);
    }
}

@keyframes focusOut {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 30%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 50%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%
        );
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(5px);
    }
    30% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        filter: blur(8px);
    }
    60% {
        background: radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 0%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 40%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 60%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 80%
        );
        filter: blur(12px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.9);
        filter: blur(15px);
    }
}

.lens-chromatic {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 6;
    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
}

.chromatic-in {
    animation: chromaticIn 0.7s ease-out forwards;
}

.chromatic-out {
    animation: chromaticOut 0.5s ease-in forwards;
}

@keyframes chromaticIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: 
            radial-gradient(circle at 45% 45%, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 55% 55%, rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.3) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.3) 0%, transparent 50%);
        transform: scale(0.9);
        filter: blur(12px);
    }
    30% {
        opacity: 0.8;
        filter: blur(6px);
    }
    60% {
        opacity: 0.6;
        filter: blur(3px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(0px);
    }
}

@keyframes chromaticOut {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        background: 
            radial-gradient(circle at 55% 55%, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 45% 45%, rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%);
        transform: scale(1.1);
        filter: blur(5px);
    }
    40% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        filter: blur(8px);
    }
    80% {
        opacity: 0.3;
        filter: blur(12px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.9);
        filter: blur(15px);
    }
}

.lens-flare {
    position: absolute;
    top: 20%;
    left: 20%;
    width: 30%;
    height: 30%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 7;
    opacity: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(
        ellipse at center,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 30%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
    );
}

.flare-in {
    animation: flareIn 0.8s ease-out forwards;
}

.flare-out {
    animation: flareOut 0.6s ease-in forwards;
}

@keyframes flareIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(0deg);
    }
    25% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        transform: scale(1.2) rotate(90deg);
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.4;
        transform: scale(1) rotate(180deg);
    }
    75% {
        opacity: 0.2;
        transform: scale(0.8) rotate(270deg);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(360deg);
    }
}

@keyframes flareOut {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(0deg);
    }
    25% {
        opacity: 0.6;
        transform: scale(1.1) rotate(-90deg);
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.3;
        transform: scale(0.9) rotate(-180deg);
    }
    75% {
        opacity: 0.1;
        transform: scale(0.7) rotate(-270deg);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.5) rotate(-360deg);
    }
}


.scale-bar {
    position: absolute;
    top: 80%;  
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 12;
    pointer-events: none;
}

 
.scale-bar-line {
    width: 120px;  
    height: 4px;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 2px;
    margin: 6px auto 0 auto;
    opacity: 0.85;
}

 
.scale-bar-text {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: white;

    font-weight: 500;
}



 

.annotations-layer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 25;
}

.annotation-marker {
    position: absolute;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.8);
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    pointer-events: all;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    z-index: 26;
    
     
    touch-action: none;
    -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

.annotation-marker:hover {
    background: transparent;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 0, 0, 1);
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.3);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.8);
     
    pointer-events: auto;
}

.annotations-layer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;  
    z-index: 25;
}


.annotation-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
    color: white;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    max-width: 200px;  
    z-index: 27;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    border-left: 3px solid #ff3232;

     
    white-space: normal;   
    word-wrap: break-word;  
    overflow-wrap: break-word;  
    box-sizing: border-box;  
}


.annotation-marker:hover + .annotation-tooltip {
    opacity: 1;
}

 
.annotation-polygons {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.annotation-polygons .annotation-polygon {
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.annotation-polygons .annotation-polygon.is-hovered {
    stroke-width: 3;
}

.annotation-polygon-tooltip.is-visible {
    opacity: 1;
}

    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: top;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: var(--fossa-compact-width, 48%);
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: 0 .45% 20px;
    padding: 0;
}

.microscope-collection--compact .scope-container {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    height: auto;
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0 auto 10px;
    padding: 0;
}

.microscope-collection--compact .scope-with-glow {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    max-width: none;
    max-height: none;
    margin: 0;
}

.microscope-collection--compact .scope-wrapper {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: none;
}

async function loadAnnotations(roiFilePath) {
  
    
    if (!roiFilePath || roiFilePath === '""' || roiFilePath === '') {
        console.log('Путь к аннотациям пустой или не указан');
        currentAnnotations = [];
        return;
    }
    
    try {

        const cleanPath = roiFilePath.replace(/^"|"$/g, ''); 
        const fullPath = cleanPath.startsWith('http') ? cleanPath : window.location.origin + cleanPath;
  
        
 
        const response = await fetch(fullPath);
       
        
        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
        }
        
		const data = await response.json();
        
        if (Array.isArray(data)) {
            
            currentAnnotations = data;
        } else if (typeof data === 'object' && data !== null) {
            
            currentAnnotations = [data];
        } else {
            currentAnnotations = [];
        }
        

        currentAnnotations.forEach((group, index) => {
            console.log(`   Группа ${index}: ${group.id}, точек: ${group.points?.length || 0}`);
        });
        
        if (showAnnotations && currentAnnotations.length > 0) {
            renderAnnotations();
        } else {
            console.log('Аннотации не показываем (showAnnotations:', showAnnotations, 'групп:', currentAnnotations.length, ')');
        }
        
    } catch (error) {
        currentAnnotations = [];
    }
}


function originalMicronsPerPixel(specimen, imageWidth) {
  const direct = Number(specimen?.image_microns_per_pixel);
  if (Number.isFinite(direct) && direct > 0) return direct;
  const legacy = Number(specimen?.microns_per_pixel);
  return Number.isFinite(legacy) && legacy > 0 && Number.isFinite(imageWidth) && imageWidth > 0
    ? legacy * 700 * (149 / 154) / imageWidth : null;
}

function measureSegment(start, end, specimen, imageWidth) {
  const pixels = Math.hypot(end.x - start.x, end.y - start.y);
  const scale = originalMicronsPerPixel(specimen, imageWidth);
  return { pixels, microns: scale === null ? null : pixels * scale };
}

function formatMeasurement(measurement, preferredUnit = '', missingScaleText = 'масштаб не задан') {
  if (measurement.microns === null) return `${Number(measurement.pixels.toFixed(2))} px · ${missingScaleText}`;
  const mm = preferredUnit === 'mm' || (!preferredUnit && measurement.microns >= 1000);
  return `${Number((measurement.microns / (mm ? 1000 : 1)).toPrecision(5))} ${mm ? 'mm' : 'µm'}`;
}




function bindImagePointDrag({ element, viewer, blocked, move, click }) {
  let drag = null;
  let suppressClick = false;
  const press = event => {
    if (blocked() || event.button !== 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    suppressClick = false;
    drag = {
      id: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY,
      offsetX: event.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2,
      offsetY: event.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2,
      navigation: viewer.isMouseNavEnabled(), moved: false,
    };
    viewer.setMouseNavEnabled(false);
    element.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  };
  const update = event => {
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.id || blocked()) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (Math.hypot(event.clientX - drag.x, event.clientY - drag.y) > 2) drag.moved = true;
    if (!drag.moved) return;
    const rect = viewer.element.getBoundingClientRect();
    move({ x: event.clientX - rect.left - drag.offsetX, y: event.clientY - rect.top - drag.offsetY });
  };
  const release = event => {
    if (!drag || (event && event.pointerId !== drag.id)) return;
    event?.stopPropagation();
    const previous = drag;
    drag = null;
    suppressClick = previous.moved;
    if (element.hasPointerCapture(previous.id)) element.releasePointerCapture(previous.id);
    viewer.setMouseNavEnabled(previous.navigation && !blocked());
  };
  const activate = event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (!blocked() && !suppressClick) click();
    suppressClick = false;
  };
  element.addEventListener('pointerdown', press);
  element.addEventListener('pointermove', update);
  element.addEventListener('click', activate);
  for (const name of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture']) element.addEventListener(name, release);
  return { destroy() {
    release();
    element.removeEventListener('pointerdown', press);
    element.removeEventListener('pointermove', update);
    element.removeEventListener('click', activate);
    for (const name of ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture']) element.removeEventListener(name, release);
  } };
}

  panel.querySelector('small').textContent = text.help;
  panel.querySelector('[data-new]').textContent = text.newLine;
  panel.querySelector('[data-close]').textContent = text.close;
